caption:
Federal student loan collections: paused, for now. ⏸️

The Education Department delayed wage garnishment and tax-refund offsets for defaulted loans on Jan 16, 2026, and no restart date has been announced. Reports say Treasury could take over collections, possibly in 2027, though nothing is confirmed.

Default can stay on a credit report for up to 7 years. Check studentaid.gov for your own status.

If you have federal loans, do you know whether yours are current?
first_comment: Have you checked your student loan status this year? 👇

card.headline: Student loan collections may restart
